name: Spider Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a round orange robot spider with big teal goggle eyes, eight banded legs and a glowing green wire web
entry: A Rotom inside a robot spider. It spins wire webs in the corners of rooms and watches through its big lens eyes.
how: Use a Spider-Bot Core on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Pollen Puff in this form.
